root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `tt_face_lookup_table( face, TTAG_glyf ) == 0` before the `CFF`-table `num_instances = 0` suppression is allowed to reduce the cached named-instance count.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: On the crashing TrueType variation path, the `CFF`-table suppression logic must not reduce the parsed `num_instances` value before `sfnt_init_face` caches the named-instance count into `face->root.style_flags`; later default-instance synthesis may only preserve or increase that count.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable code reaches the `CFF`-table suppression with a font that still has `glyf`, yet it reduces `num_instances` to zero. The fixed code requires `glyf` to be absent before the `CFF` suppression may take effect, so the named-instance count on this path is only preserved or increased by the default-instance synthesis step.

nodes.state: `TT_Get_MM_Var` stores the cached named-instance count into `mmvar->num_namedstyles`, and on the crashing path that capacity is smaller than the re-read `fvar_head.instanceCount` loop bound from the font.

At `*c = FT_GET_LONG()`, the current named-instance index `i` is already greater than or equal to `mmvar->num_namedstyles`, so the crashing write is executing on a discarded named-style slot outside the initialized range.

edges.relation: The named-instance count cached by `sfnt_init_face` in `face->root.style_flags >> 16` is reread by `TT_Get_MM_Var` and stored unchanged into `mmvar->num_namedstyles`.
The same understated `mmvar->num_namedstyles` value set during allocation is later read again at the crashing write to determine which named-style slots were actually provisioned.
The exact `ns->coords` pointer read for the current named-style record is forwarded unchanged into `c`, and `*c = FT_GET_LONG()` writes through that same pointer at the sink.
